name: Spring Meadows
title: Spring Meadows - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Spring Meadows in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The first open area of the game and the tutorial for the combat loop. It is where you meet Eveque and where most players learn that element matching matters more than raw attack.
access: On the critical path immediately after the prologue. It connects to the Abbest Cave and leads east toward the Flying Waters.
bosses: Eveque, Jar, Mime, Portier, Volester, Abbest, Lancelier
tip: Eveque tears through an unshielded party, so the practical advice is to hold your first Paint Cage rewards until after that fight.

name: Abbest Cave
title: Abbest Cave - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Abbest Cave in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A short cave off Spring Meadows named for the Abbest that nestle inside it. It is the first place the game asks you to fight a caster-type Nevron that resists Physical damage.
access: Entered from Spring Meadows. The route is signposted but the cave is optional.
tip: Bring an elemental attack. A purely physical party loses half its output to the Abbest's Physical resistance.

name: Flying Waters
title: Flying Waters - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Flying Waters in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A flooded area built around a huge anchor, holding the route to Noco's Hut and the game's second mandatory boss. It is also the area where the Bourgeon and Demineur side content sits.
access: Reached from Spring Meadows heading east. It is on the critical path, so you cannot miss it.
bosses: Goblu, Bourgeon, Mime, Bruler, Cruler, Demineur, Chromatic Bourgeon, Chromatic Bruler, Chromatic Troubadour
loot: Abysseram, Brulerum, Deminerim, Troubadim, Coral Cave hook
tip: Goblu is weak to Lightning, so Gustave's Overcharge is the single best answer. Ice is resisted and should be avoided.

name: Stone Wave Cliffs
title: Stone Wave Cliffs - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Stone Wave Cliffs in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The area that closes Act 1 and hosts Lampmaster, the game's first genuine difficulty spike. It also holds the Coralim and Delaram weapons and a large set of Paint Cages.
access: Reached at the end of Act 1 after the Flying Waters. Clear side content before advancing, because Act 2 shifts the party around.
bosses: Lampmaster, Bourgeon, Mime, Rare Sakapatate variants, Hexga, Chalier, Chation, Rangeson
tip: Lampmaster has no elemental weakness and resists Light, so bring raw damage and spend early turns destroying its lamps.

name: Gestral Village
title: Gestral Village - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Gestral Village in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The Gestral settlement and the game's biggest concentration of optional content, including the arena tournament, several merchants and the missable Medalum weapon.
access: Reached from The Continent during Act 1. Most of its content stays available later, but the tournament reward does not.
loot: Medalum (missable), Sekarum, Betelim, Trebuchim, Cultam, Demonam
tip: Medalum is missable. If you want it, win the arena tournament before the end of Act 1.

name: Ancient Sanctuary
title: Ancient Sanctuary - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Ancient Sanctuary in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A maze-like sanctuary holding the Robust and Catapult Sakapatate enemies. It is the source of Sakaram and one of the better early farming spots.
access: Entered from The Continent during Act 1. The Sanctuary Maze Flag splits into a fork; the weapon is down the left path.
bosses: Ultimate Sakapatate, Robust Sakapatate, Catapult Sakapatate, Ranger Sakapatate
tip: Fire is the answer for every Sakapatate variant, so one party setup clears the whole area.

name: the-continent
title: the-continent - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: the-continent in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The open world that connects every zone. It holds a large share of the game's optional bosses, most of the merchants and the hidden Paint Cages.
access: Unlocked progressively as the story advances. Travel is on foot until Esquie's flight ability opens the water and islands.
bosses: Bourgeon, Jar, Echassier, Gault, Ramasseur, Reaper Cultist, Chromatic Reaper Cultist, Glaise (Chosen Path)
loot: Blodam, Corpeso, Cultam, Painerim, Charnon, Direton, Yeverum
tip: Several weapons sit on small islands that are only reachable once you have Esquie's flight, so return after Act 3 begins.

name: Old Lumiere
title: Old Lumiere - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Old Lumiere in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The ruined old city, with an unmistakable bent Eiffel Tower. It is where Act 2 opens and where a set of merchant weapons become available.
access: Reached at the start of Act 2. It connects to the Monolith route.
bosses: Renoir (first proper fight), Chromatic Danseuse, Mime
loot: Danseso, Redalim, Algueron, Mellarum, Chromatic Danseuse drop
tip: Dualliste and the Chromatic Danseuse both appear around here, and both are answered by elements the area does not otherwise push you toward.

name: Forgotten Battlefield
title: Forgotten Battlefield - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Forgotten Battlefield in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A battlefield strewn with the remains of earlier expeditions. It hosts Dualliste, the first boss after Verso joins, and a number of merchant finds.
access: Reached during Act 2 as part of the Monolith route.
bosses: Dualliste, Luster, Ramasson, Greatsword Cultist, Chromatic Troubadour
loot: Dualiso, Benisim, Lusteson, Ramasson, Energising Attack I
tip: Dualliste is weak to Light and resists Fire and Dark, so a Dark-heavy Sciel build is the wrong pick for once.

name: Monoco's Station
title: Monoco's Station - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Monoco's Station in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The station settlement that unlocks once Monoco joins the party. It is the main merchant hub of Act 2 and the source of several Monoco weapons.
access: Unlocked in Act 2. Fast travel becomes available from here.
tip: Stalact's weakness flips with its stance, so bring both Fire and Ice rather than committing to one.

name: Yellow Harvest
title: Yellow Harvest - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Yellow Harvest in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A golden field area tied to the Glaise encounters and several optional bosses. It rewards elemental Fire and Ice builds.
access: Reached from The Continent in Act 2 through a portal.
bosses: Glaise (Yellow Harvest), Chromatic Orphelin, Potierim, Plenum
tip: Glaise absorbs Earth, which is the trap most players hit first. Fire and Ice both work.

name: Frozen Hearts
title: Frozen Hearts - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Frozen Hearts in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: An ice-covered region holding Gargant and a set of cold-themed weapon rewards. It is one of the areas that flight opens up.
access: Reached from The Continent once Esquie's flight is available.
tip: Gargant is the source of Snowim, one of Lune's better Ice focuses.

name: Crimson Forest
title: Crimson Forest - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Crimson Forest in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A red-tinted forest whose final boss drops Chevalam. It also holds a Paint Cage containing Nusaro.
access: Reached from The Continent in Act 2.
bosses: Chromatic Gold Chevaliere, Crimson Forest final boss
tip: You need an upgraded Esquie to cross the water to reach it, so this is effectively Act 2 late or Act 3.

name: Coastal Cave
title: Coastal Cave - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Coastal Cave in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A cave system on the coastline with a cluster of merchants and the Gobluson and Bourgelon weapons.
access: Reached from the coastal edge of The Continent.
tip: Several weapons here are bought rather than found, so bring a large amount of Chroma.

name: Act 2
title: Act 2 - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Act 2 in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A floating manor reached with Esquie. It is the source of Gesam, Seashellum and Martenon, and hosts one of the Chromatic Glissando fights.
access: Requires Esquie's flight. Located above The Continent.
tip: The Chromatic Glissando here drops Choralim for Lune, which is worth the trip on its own.

name: Act 2
title: Act 2 - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Act 2 in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A crow-themed sub-area reached laterally from The Continent, tied to the Chapelier enemy family.
access: Reached from The Continent in Act 2.
tip: The Chromatic Chapelier is the source of Minason, a Sciel weapon with heavy Luck scaling.

name: Act 2
title: Act 2 - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Act 2 in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A cave holding Elerim and the Chalium drop from the Chromatic Challier. Its entrance Flag is a useful landmark for the left-wall route to Elerim.
access: Reached from The Continent during Act 2.
tip: Hug the left wall from the entrance Flag to reach Elerim without fighting through the whole cave.

name: sirene-area
title: sirene-area - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: sirene-area in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The largest dungeon in Act 2 and home to the second Axon. It contains two mini-bosses before the main fight, and the choice you make about the Tisseur changes how hard Sirene is.
access: Reached through the Monolith route in Act 2. You must clear Glissando to reach Sirene herself.
tip: Kill the Tisseur. Sparing it costs you the Anti-Charm Pictos and lets Sirene buff her own defences.

name: visages-area
title: visages-area - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: visages-area in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The masked Axon's domain, built around three Vales. Clearing each Vale boss before the main fight directly weakens the Mask Keeper stage.
access: Reached through the Monolith route in Act 2. It is the recommended first Axon to tackle.
bosses: Visages, Mask Keeper, Jovial Moissonneuse, Seething Boucheclier, Sorrowful Chapelier, Contorsionniste, Mime
tip: Clear all three Vale bosses first. Each one you skip becomes an extra buff for Mask Keeper.

name: the-monolith
title: the-monolith - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: the-monolith in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The tower at the north of the Continent and the setting for the end of Act 2. It contains the Paint Cage system, Renoir's fight and The Paintress.
access: Reached at the end of the Act 2 route. The Paint Cage mechanic requires Paint Spikes collected across the world.
bosses: Renoir, The Paintress, Gargant, Clair Obscur, Mime, Veilleur, Noire, Obscur
loot: Lithelim, Braselim, Garganon, Veremum, Dreameso, Simoso route
tip: Bring a hit-count build for The Paintress. The 9,999 damage cap means multi-hit skills beat single heavy attacks.

name: lumiere
title: lumiere - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: lumiere in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The last human city and the setting for the endgame. Act 3 opens the city up, along with its merchants and the final boss.
access: Unlocked at the start of Act 3.
tip: Several weapons only appear from Lumiere merchants in Act 3, so recheck the shops after the act begins.

name: the-reacher
title: the-reacher - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: the-reacher in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A tall reach of terrain holding Lithum and Tireso, and Alicia's fight via Maelle's relationship questline.
access: Reached in Act 3. Alicia's encounter additionally requires Maelle's relationship level to be high enough.
tip: Alicia is gated behind Maelle's relationship level, which is why many players never find her.

name: the-abyss
title: the-abyss - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: the-abyss in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: The arena for Simon, the hardest fight in the base game and the gate to Simoso.
access: Reached in Act 3 as part of the postgame content.
tip: Simon has no elemental weakness, so the fight is entirely about build quality and parry timing. Do not attempt it before your weapons are fully upgraded.

name: renoirs-drafts
title: renoirs-drafts - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: renoirs-drafts in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A late area containing merchants with Painerim, Yeverum and Charnon, plus a Paint Cage holding Sidaro.
access: Unlocked in Act 3 as postgame content.
tip: This is the only place to buy three separate weapons, so it is worth a dedicated trip.

name: versos-drafts
title: versos-drafts - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: versos-drafts in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: A postgame area holding a cluster of expansion weapons added after launch, plus a Paint Cage with Nusaro.
access: Unlocked in Act 3 after the main story.
loot: Bonbim, Esquim, Esquiaro and other post-launch weapons
tip: Several weapons were added here in the Thank You update, so the area's loot list is longer than its Act 3 framing suggests.

name: endless-tower
title: endless-tower - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: endless-tower in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.
summary: An endless-mode tower of boss remixes, including Chromatic versions of bosses you have already beaten. It is the main endgame progression loop.
access: Unlocked in Act 3. Clearing floors rewards END rewards and unlocks further tiers.
bosses: Chromatic and remixed versions of the main roster
loot: Endless Tower rewards, high-tier Chroma, Alternate outfits
tip: Passing floor 9-3 and 11-3 awards two separate outfits, which makes the tower the main cosmetic source in the endgame.
